component.name: Kalulu
component.summary: Modern graphical music player, formerly GuiAmp, a graphical fork of cliamp

description.p: Kalulu plays local files, internet radio, podcasts, HTTP and HLS streams and the catalogs of Spotify, Qobuz, Tidal, YouTube Music, SoundCloud, Mixcloud, Navidrome, Jellyfin, Plex, Emby, Lyrion and Audiobookshelf. It has a 10-band equalizer, synced lyrics, visualizers, Lua plugins, MPRIS media controls and a remote control socket.
